text:
Ava: Quick preflight on the launch blog draft + CTAs. I added three headline variants in the doc. Need legal + growth ops check. Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/drafts/launch-hero-matrix
Marco: skimmed — nice structure. do we have alt text for hero and social variants? accessibility asked for that last quarter.
Ava: good reminder. Marco can you add alt text: 'Redwood Inference dashboard visualizing latency and throughput gains'? keep it short.
Marco: done in the asset sheet. exported 1200x628, 800x450, and a square 800x800 for socials.
Jen: legal here 12. two high-level points: 1) no superlatives without benchmark link, 2) include privacy sentence for the webinar signup (GDPR consent).
Ava: noted. I'll swap any "fastest" claims and add a one-liner for consent on the registration form.
Ravi: on benchmarks: I prefer we call out test harness and seed configs. I'll add a reproducibility appendix. small ask: in the quick table, label quantization and batch-size explicitly.
Ava: adding that now.
Ava: ```
# reproducibility appendix snippet
framework: redwood-infer-harness v0.9.2
model: redwood-2.0-serve
seq_len: 1024
batch: 16
quant: int8
hw: a100-40gb
```
Marco: looks good. For the hero we have three CTAs: A) Register Webinar B) Explore Benchmarks C) Watch Short Demo. Which hubspot lists map to these?
Olivia: Mapping proposal: A -> "Launch Webinar Registrants" B -> "Benchmark Readers" C -> "Demo Viewers". Also want to run a nurture email to webinar registrants one day before the event.
Tom: I'll create the lists and return IDs and endpoint redirects. Also will add hidden fields for utm_content and referral so we can split by CTA variant.
Leah: growth ops here 12. for the nurture drip please include the speaker bios and a 2-min demo clip. we need copy for the email subject line A/B test.
Ava: subject line variants in the doc. Leah can you choose winner by Tue morning?
Leah: yes. I'll run a quick warm-up send and pick the higher open rate.
Jen: legal suggestion for consent text: "By registering you agree to receive product updates from Redwood Inference. Manage preferences in every email."
Ava: perfect. I'll add that snippet to the registration page and the HubSpot form consent checkbox.
Ravi: one more: add a short disclaimer under the benchmark table about dataset selection and task definition. keeps things clear.
Ava: added a footnote and linked to the appendix.
Marco: design question 12. CTA hover states: green primary for Register, outline for Explore, and play icon animation for Demo. fine?
Ava: love that. Marco, include the hover GIF for demo CTA.
Marco: will export both static and hover GIFs. ETA Fri 3pm PT.
Olivia: for UTM scheme use: utm_source=redwood_blog, utm_medium=organic, utm_campaign=launch_spring, utm_content=ctaA|ctaB|ctaC. I'll wire that into the social images too.
Tom: Redirect endpoints done. HubSpot lists created: IDs 4789, 4790, 4791. DMing API keys to the team.
Ava: timeline check: final copy by Thurs 5pm, assets by Fri 3pm, legal signoff by Fri 1pm, growth ops lock by Fri 4pm. Everyone good?
Jen: Friday 11am signoff works for legal if copy updates are in by Thu evening.
Marco: assets timeline OK.
Ravi: I'll finish benchmark appendix Thu noon.
Leah: I'll prep the nurture sequence and subject test by Fri 10am.
Ava: can PublishBot create a staging preview after assets are uploaded? need an exec preview link for Monday morning.
PublishBot: Preview created: https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/launch-1728632100 (expires in 72h) :white_check_mark:
Ava: thanks. final check items: 1) alt text in assets (done) 2) consent text on form (Jen confirmed) 3) benchmark appendix link (Ravi) 4) UTM and hubspot redirects (Tom) 5) CTA hover animation (Marco). Drop any last copy notes here and I'll prepare the publish checklist. :rocket:
Marco: tiny copy nit: change "See benchmarks" to "Explore benchmarks" in CTA B to match tone.
Ava: changed.
Olivia: adding variant C copy "Watch a 2-minute demo" for clarity.
Jen: legal final 12. once the consent language is in place we are good to sign off. I'll post again when approved.
Ravi: added dataset source list to appendix.
Leah: I'll sync the email cadence with the webinar date once it's locked.
Ava: great work team. I'll consolidate into a publish ticket once legal posts the thumbs. :tada:
